name: DisequalityDispersion.identity_triple_image
typeText:
∀ {F A : Type} {arity : F → Nat} [inst : Fintype.{0} A] [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{1} A]
  (I : DisequalityDispersion.Interpretation F arity A),
  Eq.{1}
    (DisequalityDispersion.filteredTriples 0 1 (DisequalityDispersion.Term.var 2) DisequalityDispersion.pairGuard I)
    (Finset.image.{0, 0} (fun p => Prod.mk.{0, 0} p.1.1 (Prod.mk.{0, 0} p.1.2 p.2))
      (Finset.product.{0, 0} DisequalityDispersion.guardPairs.{0} Finset.univ.{0}))

source.code:
theorem identity_triple_image [Fintype A] [DecidableEq A] (I : Interpretation F arity A) :
    filteredTriples 0 1 (.var 2) pairGuard I =
      ((guardPairs (A := A)).product Finset.univ).image
        (fun p : (A × A) × A => (p.1.1,p.1.2,p.2)) := by
  classical
  ext o
  simp only [filteredTriples, Finset.mem_image]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨a,ha,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨((a 0,a 1),a 2), ?_, rfl⟩
    simp only [validAssignments, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
      valid_pairGuard] at ha
    simp [guardPairs, ha]
  · rintro ⟨p,hp,rfl⟩
    refine ⟨![p.1.1,p.1.2,p.2], ?_, ?_⟩
    · simp only [validAssignments, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and,
        valid_pairGuard]
      simpa [guardPairs] using hp
    · simp [Term.eval]
